scripts.services:start: echo 'Starting database and mailhog services...' && docker compose up -d && echo 'Services started.'
scripts.services:stop: echo 'Stopping database and mailhog services...' && docker compose down && echo 'Services stopped.'
scripts.services:reset: echo 'Resetting database and mailhog services (dropping volumes)...' && docker compose down -v && echo 'Starting fresh services...' && docker compose up -d && pnpm db:wait && echo 'Running migrations...' && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts && echo 'Services reset complete.'
scripts.db:start: echo 'Starting Postgres (db-dev, db-test)…' && docker compose up -d db-dev db-test && echo 'Postgres started.'
scripts.db:stop: echo 'Stopping Postgres (db-dev, db-test)…' && docker compose stop db-dev db-test && echo 'Postgres stopped (Mailhog left running).'
scripts.db:reset: echo 'Resetting Postgres only (dropping db volumes; Mailhog unchanged)…' && docker compose down -v db-dev db-test && echo 'Starting fresh Postgres…' && docker compose up -d db-dev db-test && pnpm db:wait && echo 'Running migrations…' && drizzle-kit migrate && tsx scripts/seed.ts && echo 'Database reset complete.'
scripts.db:seed: echo 'Running migrations…' && drizzle-kit migrate && echo 'Seeding Database' && tsx scripts/seed.ts
scripts.db:wait: echo 'Waiting for Postgres to be ready…' &&        until docker exec mruhacks-db-dev pg_isready >/dev/null 2>&1; do          printf '.';          sleep 1;        done &&        echo ' Postgres is ready.'
